subject: NYC sector leaders dinner — venue options, NDAs & vendor contract
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Meyer <anna@venuecollective.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 10:34:00 -0400
Subject: NYC sector leaders dinner — quick planning kick-off

Hi Anna + team,

Following up on our earlier call — Redwood is planning a small invite-only dinner for sector leaders in NYC (target: Tue Aug 18). Goal: 14–18 guests, C-suite + heads of data from targeted fintech and analytics accounts. We need a venue with a private dining room, discreet check-in, and the ability to review NDAs for a handful of attendees.

Key asks from our side:
- Availability for Aug 18 (evening window 6:30–9:30pm) and a backup Aug 19
- Private dining room capacity 16–20, plated 3-course, AV minimal (one mic)
- Sample venue contract and confirmation on whether you can support a venue-specific NDA amendment for selected guests
- Ballpark pricing (room rental, per-head with 3-course + wine pairing, service) and minimum spend

Attendees of this planning thread: Marissa (events lead), Laura (security/comms approvals), Tessa (procurement). Anna, if you can share venue options and a draft contract by EOD tomorrow that would be perfect — we need to route the NDA language to legal quickly.

Thanks — I’ll assemble a draft guest list once we confirm logistics.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
From: Anna Meyer <anna@venuecollective.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: NYC sector leaders dinner — quick planning kick-off

Hi Soojin — thanks for the brief. Great fit for us — we have three private dining options that meet your requirements. Attached is a high-level venue comparison + our standard contract (venue_contract_v1.pdf). Highlights:

- The Ember Room (midtown): private entrance, max 20, plated service only. Room fee: $2,000 + $150/pp (3-course + 2 glasses of wine).
- The Copper Parlour (tribeca): semi-private, intimate, max 18, no room fee, min spend $3,500 + $135/pp.
- Atelier 66 (soho): fully private, in-house AV, max 22, room fee $1,000 + $155/pp.

About NDAs: we can accommodate a short venue amendment that binds staff to not record or redistribute attendee lists and enforces limited access to registration logs. We cannot sign customer NDAs that extend to our general operations, but we can sign a one-off amendment that addresses confidentiality of guest data — I’ve flagged section 9 in the attached contract for discussion.

I attached the contract + vendor T&Cs (venue_contract_v1.pdf). If you want, I can draft language for the NDA amendment and send a DocuSign for quick approvals.

Best,
Anna Meyer
Head of Events
Venue Collective
anna@venuecollective.com
attachments: venue_contract_v1.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Anna Meyer <anna@venuecollective.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: NYC sector leaders dinner — quick planning kick-off

Thanks Anna — helpful. A few follow-ups from my side after preliminary guest outreach (I attached a draft guest list: guest_list_draft.csv):

- Confirmed interest so far: Horizon Analytics (Mike Le), FinTechX (Emma Ortiz), two PMs from LendWell, 3 product leaders from smaller fintechs.
- Two accounts (Horizon, FinTechX) will require an explicit NDA prior to sharing attendee contact details. Legal asked that the venue amendment explicitly: (a) allow us to require attendees to sign a simple event NDA, and (b) prevent venue staff from maintaining or exporting attendee contact lists beyond a 30-day retention window.
- Dietary restrictions: specify GF and vegan options; we’ll collect specifics once RSVPs are in.

Next steps from events: I’ll clean the guest list and share a final invite list by Mon Jul 26. Can we get Anna to propose the NDA amendment language and confirm whether the Ember Room or Atelier 66 can store guest lists for 30 days then purge?

—
Marissa Cole
Events Lead, GTM
marissa_cole@redwood.com
attachments: guest_list_draft.csv
From: Anna Meyer <anna@venuecollective.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: NYC sector leaders dinner — quick planning kick-off

Hi Marissa + team,

Appreciate the specifics. Quick replies:
- We can provide an NDA amendment that covers (i) limited retention of attendee contact info (30 days), (ii) prohibition on staff sharing guest lists, and (iii) a clause allowing Redwood to require attendees to sign an event-specific NDA at check-in. I attached a proposed amendment (nda_amendment_venue.docx) and highlighted the additions to section 9.
- Ember Room and Atelier 66 both confirm they can store registration logs for 30 days and then purge per your instruction. Copper Parlour prefers not to host guest data; it requires on-site check-in only and no record retention.
- Pricing note: Ember Room is the fastest to lock (small room fee + plated menu), Atelier 66 has better privacy but needs a non-refundable deposit of $1,000 to hold Aug 18.

If you’re comfortable with the amendment, I can route it through our legal and send a DocuSign that includes a single signature block for Venue Collective and your legal rep. Otherwise I’ll mark Copper Parlour as an option that requires guests not to be listed in our systems.

Best,
Anna Meyer
Venue Collective
attachments: nda_amendment_venue.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Anna Meyer <anna@venuecollective.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: NYC sector leaders dinner — quick planning kick-off

Thanks Anna — draft amendment looks reasonable at a glance. A couple of procurement/legal asks before we sign:

1) Can Anna confirm the indemnity cap language stays as-is (we prefer a venue-limited exposure) — redact any customer-specific liability expansion.
2) Procurement needs a vendor profile + W9 before we can cut the deposit. Tessa — can you confirm lead time for vendor onboarding (we usually need ~5 business days).

If Anna can push the DocuSign by EOD Mon with the amendment and an initial invoice for the deposit (if you want to hold Atelier 66) we’ll prioritize review.

—
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Meyer <anna@venuecollective.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: NYC sector leaders dinner — quick planning kick-off

All — thanks for the fast turnaround. Summary and decisions:
- We’ll reserve Atelier 66 for Aug 18 (privacy + AV) and pay the $1,000 deposit once procurement confirms vendor onboarding.
- Anna: please proceed with the NDA amendment DocuSign and include the venue’s W9 / vendor packet in the DocuSign envelope or as an attached PDF. We accept the 30-day contact retention clause as written.
- Marissa: please finalize the guest list and flag Horizon + FinTechX contacts so we can send pre-sign NDA notices.
- Laura/Tessa: let us know vendor onboarding ETA; if we need to shift the deposit timeline we’ll prioritize.

Anna — copy me when you send the DocuSign and invoice; I’ll chase signatures internally.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Field Marketing Manager
soojin_lee@redwood.com
From: Mike Le <mike.le@horizon-analytics.com>

Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: NYC sector leaders dinner — quick planning kick-off

Soojin / Marissa — thanks for the update and for accommodating NDA requirements. Horizon is happy to attend Aug 18 and I’ll have our legal sign the event NDA at check-in if that’s simplest. A couple of quick notes for the guest list:

- I’ll attend plus our Head of Data (Sara Cho).
- Dietary: Sara is vegetarian; I’m GF.
- If you need a contact card for our procurement for any paperwork, please use procurement@horizon-analytics.com.

Looking forward to the event.

—
Mike Le
VP, Product & Data
Horizon Analytics
